prompts: Describe only what is visibly present in this image in one coherent paragraph. Focus on the main objects carrying text, their shapes, colors and surfaces, the placement and arrangement of the lettering, and nearby objects and background details. Mention spatial relationships and lighting where visible. Include readable words only when clear; do not guess an unreadable transcription or a named location. For a tight crop, describe the visible close-up rather than inventing a wider setting. Aim for 80 to 140 words when the image supports that detail. Avoid repetition and speculation. Return only the visual description.
